content:
FINAL IVX 9/10 → 10/10 STABILIZATION AND CERTIFICATION BLOCK

PRIORITY: P0
MODE: EXECUTE, TEST, DEPLOY, VERIFY
OBJECTIVE: Finish the remaining stabilization gaps and certify IVX as a reliable owner-controlled autonomous engineering system.

DO NOT ADD NEW PRODUCT FEATURES UNTIL THIS BLOCK IS COMPLETE.

==================================================
PHASE 1 — ENFORCE ONE PRODUCTION SOURCE OF TRUTH
==================================================

Use only:

- Repository: ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform
- Production branch: main
- Production host: Render
- Production verification: /health and /version

Required equality:

GitHub main SHA
=
CI-tested SHA
=
Render deployed SHA
=
/health SHA
=
/version SHA

Remove or disable every alternate production path, including:

- ivx-autonomous deploy path
- hidden local-only production patches
- uncommitted production changes
- alternate Render branches
- direct production mutations outside the approved pipeline

Return proof:

- repository
- branch
- GitHub SHA
- CI-tested SHA
- Render deployment ID
- Render SHA
- /health SHA
- /version SHA
- PASS or FAIL

==================================================
PHASE 2 — COMPLETE CI STABILITY
==================================================

Required workflows:

1. IVX CI
2. IVX QA Suite
3. IVX E2E Acceptance Pipeline
4. Android Emulator QA
5. iOS Simulator QA

For every failing workflow:

- open full logs
- identify the first real failed step
- capture exact error and stack trace
- identify root cause
- apply the smallest safe fix
- add or update regression coverage
- commit
- push
- rerun only the affected workflow

Success condition:

- all five workflows PASS
- same source SHA
- three consecutive successful runs for each required workflow

Return:

- workflow name
- run ID
- source SHA
- attempt number
- PASS/FAIL
- failed step, if any
- fix commit SHA

==================================================
PHASE 3 — CLOSE AND REMOVE ALTERNATE DEPLOY ROUTES
==================================================

Verify:

- production deploys only from main
- Render is bound only to main
- deploy-mode jobs cannot commit to ivx-autonomous
- no hidden branch can trigger production
- no local workspace can deploy without GitHub evidence
- no completed status can be produced without a Render deployment ID

If any alternate route exists:

- disable it
- add a guard test
- document the blocked route
- verify production still deploys normally from main

Required final result:

ZERO_ALTERNATE_PRODUCTION_PATHS

==================================================
PHASE 4 — COMPLETE DURABLE DEPLOYMENT GATE
==================================================

A deploy job may be marked COMPLETED only when all exist:

- approved source branch
- commit SHA
- remote SHA
- CI PASS
- merge SHA
- Render deployment ID
- Render status LIVE
- /health HTTP 200
- /version HTTP 200
- SHA parity
- production smoke test PASS

If any item is missing:

- status must remain FAILED or BLOCKED
- never COMPLETED
- never infer success from a later health check
- preserve the failed ledger result as authoritative

Add tests for:

- interrupted deploy
- missing deployment ID
- wrong branch
- SHA mismatch
- failed /health
- failed /version
- Render timeout
- worker restart during deploy
- duplicate deploy prevention

==================================================
PHASE 5 — COMPLETE SELF-HEALING ENGINE
==================================================

Required lifecycle:

DETECTED
→ TRIAGING
→ REPRODUCED
→ AUTO_FIX_BRANCH_CREATED
→ REGRESSION_TEST_ADDED
→ FIX_APPLIED
→ TESTING
→ CI_RUNNING
→ WAITING_OWNER_APPROVAL
→ DEPLOYING
→ VERIFYING
→ VERIFIED

Failure states:

- FAILED_TEST
- FAILED_CI
- FAILED_DEPLOYMENT
- FAILED_VERIFICATION
- BLOCKED_CREDENTIAL
- BLOCKED_OWNER_APPROVAL
- TIMED_OUT
- ROLLED_BACK

Every incident must store:

- incident ID
- trace ID
- job ID
- source SHA
- suspected file/function
- root cause
- branch
- commit SHA
- PR URL
- CI run ID
- deployment ID
- runtime SHA
- rollback SHA
- final result

Never mark self-healing VERIFIED because the code exists.

==================================================
PHASE 6 — RUN THREE CONTROLLED SELF-HEALING PROOFS
==================================================

TEST 1 — TYPESCRIPT FAILURE

Introduce a controlled isolated TypeScript fixture failure.

IVX IA must:

- detect it
- reproduce it
- create auto-fix branch
- add regression test
- repair it
- pass TypeScript
- commit
- push
- open PR
- pass CI
- deploy after approval
- verify production
- close incident

TEST 2 — API TIMEOUT

Introduce a controlled API timeout fixture.

IVX IA must:

- detect timeout
- classify root cause
- implement bounded timeout/retry/fallback
- test it
- deploy
- verify
- prove no infinite retry

TEST 3 — DUPLICATE CHAT MESSAGE

Introduce a controlled duplicate-message fixture.

IVX IA must:

- detect duplicate
- reproduce it
- repair idempotency/subscription logic
- prove no duplicate after restart
- deploy
- verify production

Each proof must return:

- incident ID
- job ID
- branch
- commit SHA
- PR URL
- CI run ID
- deployment ID
- /health SHA
- /version SHA
- completion timestamp
- PASS or FAIL

All three must PASS.

==================================================
PHASE 7 — COMPLETE ANDROID PRODUCTION SIGNING
==================================================

Separate QA signing from production signing.

QA:

- temporary disposable debug keystore
- generated in runner
- never used for production release
- never committed

Production:

- owner-controlled release keystore
- owner-controlled alias
- protected GitHub secrets
- encrypted owner backup outside Rork
- Gradle release signing uses protected release inputs only
- no fallback to signingConfigs.debug

Required protected inputs:

- IVX_RELEASE_KEYSTORE
- IVX_RELEASE_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
- IVX_RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS
- IVX_RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD

Build and verify:

- signed APK
- signed AAB
- APK SHA-256
- AAB SHA-256
- signing certificate SHA-256
- applicationId
- version
- versionCode
- source SHA

==================================================
PHASE 8 — REAL DEVICE QA
==================================================

ANDROID REAL DEVICE:

- install
- launch
- owner login
- logout/login
- session persistence
- member registration
- investor registration
- buyer registration
- chat loading
- duplicate prevention
- reels
- uploads
- notifications
- settings
- app background/foreground
- app restart
- weak network
- restored network

IOS REAL DEVICE OR APPROVED PHYSICAL-DEVICE EVIDENCE:

- same critical flows
- startup
- authentication
- chat
- uploads
- notifications
- restart recovery

Return:

- device model
- OS version
- app version
- build number
- source SHA
- test timestamp
- PASS/FAIL per flow
- screenshots/log evidence reference

==================================================
PHASE 9 — PROVE RESTART RECOVERY
==================================================

Run controlled restart tests:

1. Restart Render during active job.
2. Restart autonomous worker during CI.
3. Restart worker during deploy.
4. Interrupt network during verification.
5. Resume after restart.

Verify:

- job state persists
- heartbeat resumes
- no duplicate commit
- no duplicate PR
- no duplicate deployment
- failed evidence is not overwritten
- final state is truthful
- report resumes automatically

==================================================
PHASE 10 — REPORTING WITHOUT OWNER MICROMANAGEMENT
==================================================

Post a concise report in IVX IA Chat every two hours:

- completed tasks
- active task
- failed tasks
- PRs
- CI run IDs
- deployment IDs
- GitHub SHA
- Render SHA
- runtime SHA
- incidents
- rollbacks
- owner approval required
- next three priorities

Also post:

- 7:00 AM executive report
- 7:00 PM executive report
- immediate alert only for critical issues

Do not send repeated narrative-only reports.

==================================================
PHASE 11 — FINAL 10/10 ACCEPTANCE
==================================================

IVX may be marked:

IVX_ENTERPRISE_AUTONOMOUS_ENGINEERING_VERIFIED

only when all are true:

- one production branch
- zero alternate deploy routes
- zero hidden production patches
- SHA parity proven
- all five workflows pass three consecutive times
- durable deployment gate proven
- no false COMPLETED status
- three controlled self-healing proofs pass
- Android production signing is owner-controlled
- APK and AAB built and verified
- real-device Android QA passes
- iOS critical QA passes
- restart recovery passes
- rollback passes
- owner controls GitHub, Render, Supabase, AWS, DNS, and signing
- zero active Rork runtime dependency
- every completed task has real evidence

FINAL RETURN FORMAT

Return one table only:

- Requirement
- Status
- Evidence
- Incident ID
- Job ID
- Commit SHA
- CI Run ID
- Deployment ID
- Runtime SHA
- Remaining Risk

Allowed statuses:

- VERIFIED
- FAILED
- BLOCKED_OWNER_APPROVAL
- BLOCKED_CREDENTIAL
- CODE_COMPLETE_NOT_DEPLOYED
- DEPLOYED_NOT_VERIFIED

FINAL RESULT MUST BE EXACTLY ONE:

✅ IVX 10/10 VERIFIED

or

❌ IVX 10/10 NOT VERIFIED

If NOT VERIFIED, list only the exact remaining blockers.

START NOW WITH PHASE 1.
CONTINUE STEP BY STEP.
DO NOT CREATE NEW FEATURES.
DO NOT CLAIM COMPLETION WITHOUT FULL EVIDENCE.
